t: You're in Red Lion Square, a small square in Holborn. Nicholas Barbon laid it out in 1684, and it takes its name from the Red Lion Inn. According to some sources, the bodies of three regicides, Oliver Cromwell, John Bradshaw and Henry Ireton, were placed in a pit on the site of the square. The historian Sharon Turner died here. He was an English historian, born in 1768, who died in 1847.
